description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcels in Ihalakaragamahuna South, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510838 and 10 other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. These notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land parcel registrations across various districts. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, ownership claims, title settlements, and property boundary determinations.
